subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on benchmarking — calendar & load test plan
messages:
From: Tom Willis <tom.willis@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kira Brown <kbrown@greenship.io>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed dates and throughput targets

Hi Hannah / Connor,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. We're ready to kick off the hands-on POC for our conversational support workflow. High-level asks from our side:
- Half-day working session (prompt review + routing) followed by a shorter load/benchmark run the next day
- Target sustained throughput: 250 qps for token-generation (50 tokens avg)
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for the simple prompts; p95 < 700ms for the multi-turn prompts

Proposed times (all PDT):
- Option A: Tue 2028-06-27, 09:00–13:00 (workshop), Wed 2028-06-28, 10:00–11:30 (load run)
- Option B: Thu 2028-06-29, 12:00–16:00 (workshop), Fri 2028-06-30, 09:30–11:00 (load run)

I'll attach a one-pager with our sample prompts and a short list of firewall IPs that need exception (will follow in a separate note). Please confirm availability and whether you need any special infra on our side.

Thanks,
Tom
---
Tom Willis
Head of ML Engineering, Acme Corp
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Willis <tom.willis@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed dates and throughput targets

Hi Tom — great, and thanks for the clear targets. We're excited to run this with you. A few quick notes before we lock calendar invites: 

1) Workshop scope and agenda- please confirm you want prompt review, routing policy walkthrough, and a short run through the test harness (we'll include a short primer on KV cache handling and prefix caching). I've attached a lightweight agenda draft.

2) Load test expectations- 250 qps sustained is doable on our Dedicated profile but we should validate peak burst expectations. Can you confirm: 50 tokens average per request is the mean you expect across the prompt set? Also, do you have a target duration for the sustained window (e.g., 10m / 30m / 60m)?

3) Test harness & access- please share the sample prompt file (jsonl) and any auth tokens we should expect. We can run the harness from our staging cluster; if you'd prefer a joint run from your environment, we can provide the runner and instructions.

Proposed availability from our side: Option A works for Marissa and me; Connor prefers Option B but can be flexible if we make the load run shorter. Can we tentatively hold Option A and I will confirm by EOD?

Attachment: kickoff_agenda.pdf (agenda draft)

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Willis <tom.willis@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kira Brown <kbrown@greenship.io>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed dates and throughput targets

Thanks Hannah — attaching the prompt set we mentioned. Quick answers:
- Yes, ~50 tokens avg is correct (we have a small tail up to 120 tokens on rare flows)
- Preferred sustained window: 30 minutes, and a 5-minute warm-up / cool-down on either side
- We'll host the harness in our test VPC; repo is available here: https://github.com/acme/poc-test-harness (read-only for your team)

Attachments: sample_prompt_set.jsonl

Also looping in Kira from Greenship (our cloud infra partner) in case we need to coordinate egress IPs and load generator placement.

Tom
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Willis <tom.willis@acme.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed dates and throughput targets

Tom / Kira — thanks for the prompt set and clarifications. A few operational items so we can make the load run reliable: 
- We'll need the list of egress IPs (or VPC peering info) 48 hours before the run for firewall rules.
- For the sustained 250 qps over 30m we recommend a staging profile: 3x parallel workers with continuous batching enabled (we'll share the exact config).
- Please confirm whether your harness will use the same key for all workers or rotating keys (rotating keys are preferred so we can clearly isolate per-worker traces).

I've attached an initial loadplan (loadplan_v1.md) with recommended ramps, target track, and a suggested metric set (throughput, p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU util, token/sec).

Proposed concrete schedule to lock in:
- Workshop: Tue 2028-06-27, 09:00–13:00 PT (Hannah / Marissa on host)
- Load run: Wed 2028-06-28, 10:00–11:30 PT (Connor leading load execution)

If that works for Acme we'll send calendar invites with a runbook attached.

Attachment: loadplan_v1.md

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
